class.name: FoundryBuildTask
class.brief_description: Base class for script-backed Foundry build task providers.
class.description: Build task provider scripts listed in project or addon build metadata must declare a [code]class_name[/code] that extends [FoundryBuildTask]. Build-task bootstrap loading instantiates these scripts with dependencies restricted to the build API and provider-local or addon-local helper scripts. Native build tooling invokes provider hooks through script dispatch so Foundry Script subclasses can implement them.

method.name: get_config_schema
method.description: Returns the provider-specific configuration schema. Schema loading is intended for trusted providers and is not required when listing untrusted providers. Foundry Script providers may override this hook.

method.name: run
method.description: Runs the build task for [param context] and returns the task result. Foundry Script providers may override this hook.
